_doc: ledger v6 (NS3, D4): the lever rule catalog read by ledger_diag.levers(). Every lever carries a rule id, a number and its parameters; a lever without a number is not emitted. delivery_cut: per_week is the 'order in' cap the rule proposes, min_count the smallest month it speaks about; drop_droppable: min_amount; saving_last_resort is offered only when no spend-side lever closes the gap (D4), share = how much of the stream it proposes to cut. The owner-facing words are the service's (ledgerlib/diagtext.py, i18n ledger.diag.lever.*).
